title: Unrailed!
summary: Procedurally generated co-op railway-building game where players gather resources, lay track and coordinate under time pressure to keep a moving train from derailing.

observations.statement: Cooperative coordination, role sharing and frantic teamwork are repeatedly described as the core strength, especially with friends.
The endless procedural structure can escalate into a demanding and sometimes brutal coordination challenge.
One reviewed user specifically wanted a more traditional campaign alongside the endless/procedural structure.

steam_reviews.query: Steam Community review pages; Russian and non-Russian lanes attempted; accessible index was sparse
